description: This is a test class for the VisitDAO component in the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests for methods of the VisitDAO class, verifying behaviors like retrieving visits based on their status and types, involving specific XML datasets. The class extends a base test class, uses annotations for setup and test methods, and interacts with the database through DAO methods.

classes.name: VisitDAOTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing VisitDAO methods within the OpenMRS project, validating visit retrieval and filtering functionalities.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes the DAO instance before each test by fetching it from the application context, ensuring a fresh state for each test execution.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldReturnAllUnvoidedVisitsIfIncludeEndedIsSetToTrue
methods.description: Tests that the getVisits method returns all non-voided visits, including ended visits, when the includeEnded parameter is true.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldReturnOnlyActiveVisitsIfIncludeEndedIsSetToFalse
methods.description: Verifies that getVisits returns only active (not ended) visits when includeEnded is false.

methods.name: getNextVisit_shouldReturnTheNextUnvoidedActiveVisitMatchingTheSpecifiedTypesAndStartDate
methods.description: Checks that getNextVisit returns the correct subsequent visit based on visit types and a specified start date.
